published_title: Pete's Endor Ops  aka  What's That Do
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Ghetto 13''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
description: The ultimate meta-game choice for QMC, RST, and sometimes even WYS.  And it's fckin' fun.

posted: Tatooine (for Profit or Slave Quarters Jank)

posted: There'll Be Hell to Pay
posted: Heavy Fire Zone (What's that do?)
posted: I Can't Shake Him x2

notes: Posted 26 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Crap (8)': Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, Endor, Endor: Bunker, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay), Prepared Defenses, Combat Response, Oppressive Enforcement and Planetary Subjugation; these count toward the 60.
A GenCon edit says the deck went 3-1 at GenCon ('a major Con'), including 2-0 against WYS; the post does not name the event beyond GenCon.

Posted 'Endor Operations/Impossible Flip' dested Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost; Endor, Endor Bunker, Endor Landing Platform, Kashyyyk, Sullust, Tatooine and Kessel dested their Dark pages (Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere)).

Posted 'Oppresive Enforcement (Old-school, NOT the combo)' dested the Endor Effect Oppressive Enforcement; 'Vader w/ Glowstick' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber (the strategy calls him 'EPP Vader'); 'Dreadnaught' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Dark Maneuvers/Tallon Roll' the combo Dark Maneuvers & Tallon Roll; 'U-3PO' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).
Secret Plans is an Effect in this era, counted in the 60.
The 'Dudes (12)' header was mis-read as a card and has been dropped.

A later GENCON EDIT in the post says the deck went 3–1 at GenCon ("I'll still take 3-1 at a major Con"); it names no event, so the deck is not tied to the 2001 North American Continental Championship.
